div.div: سَمِيدٌ i. q. حُوَّارَى (A, K) [app. as meaning White, or whitened, flour: but said in the TK to mean fine bread]: accord. to Kr, i. q. طَعَامٌ [app. as meaning wheat]; and said by him to be with the unpointed د: (K:) but more chastely, (K,) and better known, (TA,) with ذ. (K, TA.) [In the present day, applied to Semoulia; a kind of paste made of very fine wheat-flour, reduced to small grains. See also إِسْمِيدٌ, below.]
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
